title: Saudi Arabia’s November climate records reveal second-highest average monthly rainfall
summary: JEDDAH — November is historically Saudi Arabia’s second-wettest month of the year, averaging 13.29 millimeters of rainfall based on climate records from 1991 to 2020, according to the NCM. The center’s historical analysis, covering records from 1985 to 2025, shows that November rainfall is generally concentrated in central Saudi Arabia and parts of the Kingdom’s western and eastern regions. Based on the 1991–2020 climatic reference period, Al-Qassim records the highest average November rainfall among monitored stations at 29.3 millimeters, followed by Qaisumah at 27.2 millimeters, Jeddah at 27.1 millimeters, Makkah at 25.1 millimeters and Taif at 23.1 millimeters.
